system.colour: Warm paper palette, defined as CSS variables in app/globals.css and used only through Tailwind tokens. Light: page #FBF7F1, card #FFFDF9, tinted panel #F4EDE3, hairline #E9DFD2; text #2B221D / #5F524A / #70635A. One dark fill for primary buttons, the FAB and badges (espresso #3D2C22); links and numbers in cocoa #6C3A1C; apricot #E2925C as decoration only (tape, heart, active-tab dot). Meaning colours: period red #B83442 and fertile violet #7054C8 (each kept for that one meaning), ok green #1E7850, warn amber #965F0A, him blue #3464AA, her pink #B43C68, each with a soft tint. As it appears: a calm beige-and-brown app with one violet state and one red button; coherent. Costs: cards are only 1.05:1 away from the page, so a soft shadow does the separating; up to six pastel tints share one screen (the link page has peach, beige, violet, mint, blue and pink); him = blue and her = pink is the conventional gender code.
system.typography: No font is shipped: the stack starts with Pretendard but there is no @font-face or font file, so each phone shows its own system Korean font (my captures fell back to WenQuanYi Zen Hei + Inter, so glyph shapes in the screenshots are not what an iPhone or Galaxy shows). Weights 400/500/600/700/800 are all in use. Rendered on her home: 17 sizes (10, 11, 11.5, 12, 12.5, 13, 13.5, 14, 14.5, 15, 15.5, 16, 17, 20, 21, 23, 24px), 30 size×weight pairs, 7 text colours; his home 17 sizes / 34 pairs; link page 16 / 33. In source: 22 arbitrary px sizes (440 uses of text-[Npx]) on top of 7 Tailwind steps. Hierarchy as seen: greeting 20px/800, card title 23px/800, section title 17px/800, body 12.5–13.5px, captions 11–12px. Body text is small: 83% of the characters on her home are 13.5px or smaller and 51% are 12.5px or smaller (his home 76% / 52%). Headings use tight negative tracking and heavy weights; numbers are tabular.
system.iconography_illustration: Two icon languages side by side. (1) A custom inline-SVG line set: 56 icons, 24px grid, 1.8 stroke, used in the tab bar, header, list rows and buttons; consistent. (2) Emoji as avatars, icons and illustration: people are 👩 👨 🧑 👧 in tinted circles; 콕/응원 and signal chips, reply chips, notification rows (🗒️ 🙏 👏 ✅ 💞 📝 👉 🔔), mood and reaction pickers, anniversaries (💞 💍 🎉), date ideas (🌲 🌇), baby size (a citrus emoji) and milestones (🐢 👣). At least 85 distinct emoji in UI source; visible on one screen: her home 15, 챙길 것 27, 우리 43. Illustration: one flat SVG landscape (hills, a tree, sun or moon, two birds) in a taped polaroid, recoloured for morning/day/evening/night plus a muted set; a Han-river sunset SVG as the demo cover; test-strip pictograms on the LH and 임테기 buttons (the best custom drawing in the app); the cycle ring; one line drawing for add-to-home-screen. No mascot, no drawn people, no illustrated empty states. Brand mark: two overlapping circles and a small dot, blue + pink on the welcome screen and cream + tan on the app icon; inside the app only the text 둘셋.
system.layout_density: Single column, 16px gutters; sticky header 57px (92px with the demo-date banner), tab bar 65px with a 56px centre FAB; everything is a rounded card. Page heights at 390×844 (light, demo couple, banner included): her home 1951px = 2.31 screens (2847px = 3.37 with 더 보기 open); his home 2567px = 3.04; partner link 3352px = 3.97 (4023px = 4.77 on first open); pregnant her / him 2689 / 2783; parenting her / him 2446 / 2513; fresh couple her / him 1472 / 2611; at 375×667 her / him 1793px (2.69 screens) / 2316px (3.47). Other tabs: 주기 her 2215, him 1134; 챙길 것 3490 (4.14 screens); 우리 3887 (4.61); 설정 1245 collapsed, 6577 (7.79) with all 11 sections open. Card-like surfaces at top level (at least 60% wide, radius 12px or more, own fill, shadow or border; the cover polaroid is extra): her home 5 (+5 behind 더 보기), his home 8, link 10 (+8 nested), pregnant 9 / 10, parenting 10 / 11, fresh her 5, fresh him 8 (+4 nested). First viewport of her home: greeting, cover (266px = 39% of the 687px between header and tab bar), status card; 오늘 할 일 starts under the tab bar. His: cover (166px), one 319px text card, the title of the next card. Rhythm is uneven: card radii 24/22/20/12px, inner paddings 18/14/16/10px, gaps between stacked cards 18/14/10px on his home, left edges at 16, 18 and 20–25px.
system.components: Card (six tones), primary button (espresso; full pill on welcome and home, 12px-radius rectangle in onboarding, sheets and stage heroes), soft secondary button, text link with chevron, chips (choice, filter, signal), radio cards, switch, number stepper, segmented control (log sheet, 우리), bottom sheet with grabber and drag-to-close, pill toast with 되돌리기, check rows, progress bar, D-day badge, date tile, cycle ring, week strip, month calendar with five day marks (solid red, dashed red, tinted violet, solid violet, hatched) plus a star, a dot and a 희미 tag, accordion with a sticky chip index (설정), polaroid cover, tab bar + FAB, dashed empty box. The + 기록 sheet is the most finished piece: date stepper, four tabs, two or three large answers, saves on tap. Inconsistencies: four looks for a check (circle on the right in 오늘 할 일; circle on the left for 이번 주 내가 맡을 것 하나; square box in 내 준비 and 챙길 것; bordered row with a square box on the link page and the parenting home); section titles sometimes outside the card (17px heading), sometimes inside as a small coloured label; tab order changes by stage (preparing 오늘·주기·+·챙길 것·우리; pregnant 오늘·임신·챙길 것·우리 with + only on his screen; parenting 오늘·아기·우리·챙길 것); native date inputs in onboarding, the log sheet, 우리 and 설정.
system.motion_feedback: Read from stills and the source, not from video: there is almost no motion. No @keyframes anywhere; the only animation is a pulse on a loading label. Transitions: colour on press and hover, chevron rotation, switch knob, the check circle filling (120ms), progress bars (500ms), cover photo fade (200ms), a sheet settling after a drag (160ms). Sheets, toasts and tab changes appear at once, with no enter or exit animation; no haptics, no celebration, no skeletons except photo placeholders. The feedback that exists is clear: tap-to-save with a toast and 되돌리기 (오늘 시작으로 남겼어요 · 되돌리기), the home card changing state right after a log (생리 1일째 · 이번 주기도 수고했어요, then 알릴까요?), counters (0/4 to 4/4), a green line 오늘 할 일을 모두 마쳤어요 and a toast 오늘 체크를 모두 마쳤어요. 민수님에게 알렸어요. Toasts sit above the tab bar and cover content while shown; while a sheet is open or just after a log they move to the top and cover the header.
system.dark_mode: Follows the phone setting only (prefers-color-scheme); 설정 has no theme switch. Every screen was captured in dark and none broke. Page #16110E, cards one step lighter with a hairline instead of a shadow, the primary fill flips from espresso to cream #F0CFA8 with dark text, accents are lightened and stay readable, the cover illustration always uses its night palette, cover photos are dimmed. Lowest measured text contrast in dark: 4.90:1 across 13 screens. It looks deliberate and warm. Weak spots: the salmon demo cover and the cream FAB are the two brightest objects and pull the eye; tinted cards (the violet 주기 summary, the brown stage hero) are heavy blocks.
system.accessibility: Strong on the measurable basics. Text contrast: every visible text node is at least 4.5:1 on 13 screens in both themes (lowest 4.67 light, 4.90 dark); the one miss is a disabled button label (3.47 / 2.44), which WCAG exempts. Controls with no accessible name: 0 of 33 / 63 / 69 / 53 on 오늘 / 주기 / 챙길 것 / 우리. Emoji are aria-hidden, icon-only buttons have labels, one h1 per screen, header/nav/main landmarks, lang=ko, checks are role=checkbox, sheets are aria-modal with the background inert, 2px focus ring, a prefers-reduced-motion rule, forced-colors fallbacks, pinch zoom is not blocked. Small pills are 36px tall on screen but padded to 44px hit areas. Calendar states use pattern as well as colour. Gaps: text under 12px is common (12 text nodes on her home, 32 on the pregnant home, 112 on 챙길 것; 10px labels in the cycle ring and badges); most sizes are fixed px and will not follow a larger system text size; the calendar needs a six-swatch legend. Not tested with VoiceOver or TalkBack: this is a static reading.
system.tone_of_voice: 해요체, short, concrete, no exclamation marks, no cheerleading. Predictions always say 예상; pressure words are avoided (우리의 주간; 이 기간엔 하루나 이틀에 한 번이면 충분해요). Kind at hard moments (이번 주기도 수고했어요), and telling him is offered as a choice (민수님에게 알릴까요? ‘이번 달은 쉬어 가요’라고만 전해요). Privacy consequences are stated where the choice is made (링크가 있는 사람은 누구나 이 화면을 볼 수 있어요). Empty states are one plain line (새 알림이 없어요). Costs: the amount of text. His task card carries office detail at 12.5px (검사 마감 2월 3일 (수) · 신청 후 3개월 안, plus a paragraph about medication); a not-for-contraception line appears on every log sheet, on 주기 and in onboarding, in two wordings (날짜 예상은 참고용이에요. 피임 목적으로 쓰면 안 돼요); some labels sound internal (기다리는 주, 우리 한 줄, 달력 기준 · 설정값). The demo-date banner and the ⇄ …님 화면으로 바꾸기 pill are prototype furniture, not product.

first_run: Screens: welcome + 4 steps (① 우리 둘 ② 주기 ③ 동의·공유 ④ 초대·설치) = 5 screens, then home. Welcome: polaroid landscape, mark + 둘셋, the line 남편이 같이 하는 임신 준비, sub-copy, 시작하기, 백업 파일로 복원하기, 준비 중 예시 보기; the lower ~150px of 844 is empty and nothing shows the product. ① two name fields (optional), two role pickers (required, three options each), whose cycle (filled in automatically once roles are chosen). ② one date field with five quick chips and 잘 모르겠어요 · 나중에 할게요 (all optional); a collapsed 더 넣기 holds average cycle, an irregular-cycle switch, period length and LH use. ③ share level (three radio cards, 우리의 주간 preselected), two required consent checkboxes, three 자세히 disclosures; 415 characters, 1030px tall, so the second checkbox is below the first viewport. ④ 카톡으로 링크 보내기 (optional), an install tip, 시작하기. Required decisions: 4 (two roles, two consents). Measured path: 10 taps + 2 typed names; minimum 9 taps with no typing (the app then calls her 아내님). Time: not timed with people; about one minute is my estimate. Time to first value for her: immediate. From one date the first home shows 가임기 범위예요 (넓음) · 주기 15일째; with no date it shows one card, 마지막 생리 시작일을 알려 주세요, and logging takes 2 taps. For him nothing happens until he opens his screen: in the app a 933px sheet with four questions (smoking, drinking, an optional already-doing, how to get news; 13 buttons) that cannot be passed until the first two are answered; on the link page three of those questions sit as a card on top of a page that is 4023px (4.77 screens) on first open, and there he can skip them. Taps to log a period: 2 on the empty home (+ → 오늘 시작, the sheet opens on 생리) and 2 from the home card on and after the due date (생리 시작 기록 → 오늘 시작); 3 through + in mid-cycle, because the sheet then opens on LH (+ → 생리 → 오늘 시작).
strengths: A recognisable warm palette (paper, espresso, apricot); violet and red are each kept for one meaning.
Dark mode is complete and tuned rather than inverted: every captured screen holds up, lowest text contrast 4.90:1.
Accessibility basics are measured, not assumed: all text at least 4.5:1 in both themes, no unnamed controls on four tabs, 44px hit areas, focus ring, reduced-motion and forced-colors rules.
The + 기록 sheet: one sheet, four tabs, tap-to-save with 되돌리기; a period takes 2–3 taps and the home answers at once with a changed card.
Her home leads with one state card and a clear primary button (+ LH 기록, + 생리 시작 기록), and the cycle ring reads at a glance.
Copy is short, adult and kind: no exclamation marks, no fake cheer, predictions always labelled 예상, sharing consequences stated where the choice is made.
The two-person idea is visible in the design: his 주기 tab is a narrower view (1134px against her 2215px), signals come with ready replies, and telling him about a period is a choice on the card.
The first run is short: 4 required decisions, about 10 taps, value on the first home; the empty home has one obvious next action.
The cover polaroid gives the home a personal object and is the one distinctive visual idea; on short screens it shrinks so the action card stays above the tab bar.
The partner link opens without install, and 설정 has a preview of what he will see.
No horizontal scroll on any captured screen at 390 or 375 wide; sheets fit 375×667.

summary: 둘셋 looks like a careful, warm, accessible prototype, not yet like a top consumer app. Already good: the palette, dark mode, contrast and labelling, the + 기록 sheet, the copy, a short first run. What a senior product designer would mark first: (1) his screens are three to four screens of small text and cards, the opposite of the promise; (2) emoji stand in for avatars, icons and illustration; (3) there is no ownable brand (mark, typeface, illustration); (4) 17 font sizes on one screen and body text at 12.5–13.5px; (5) no motion; (6) uneven card rhythm. Measured at 390×844: her home 1951px with 5 cards (+5 behind 더 보기), his home 2567px with 8 cards, link page 3352px with 10 cards; 17 font sizes and 5 weights on each home; a period takes 2 taps on the empty home or from the home card near the due date, and 3 through + in mid-cycle; onboarding is welcome + 4 steps with 4 required decisions and about 10 taps. Limits: still captures in headless Chromium with a fallback font, no real phone, no screen reader, no timing with people; heights include a 35px demo-date banner. This audit makes no claims about other apps. The saved file also carries a measurements block.

measurements.conditions: Next.js dev server, headless Chromium (Playwright 1.63), viewport 390×844 at device scale 2, locale ko-KR, ?today=2026-11-13, clock fixed at 10:30 KST, demo couple 민수·지은 unless stated. Heights include the 35px demo-date banner that only shows when the date is pinned. Counts ignore content inside closed 더 보기 blocks.
measurements.cardRule: Card-like surface = visible element in <main>, at least 60% of the viewport wide and 48px tall, corner radius 12px or more, with its own fill, shadow or border; pills excluded; top level = not inside another such surface. The cover polaroid (5px radius) is not counted.
